rows.grounds: locative singular of maṇipūra, the ten-petaled cakra
compound daśa+dala in locative singular agreeing with maṇipūra
past participle of gam in nominative singular masculine

items.question: What is the result when the vital breath has entered the ten-petaled maṇipūra through the suṣumnā?
items.inference: The verse states a conditional stage of prāṇic ascent.
uncertainties: The exact subject, prāṇa or kuṇḍalinī, is not explicit in this fragment.
items.plain_english: When [the breath] has gone into the suṣumnā in the ten-petaled maṇipūra.
